title: Nights
author: Nidhi Garga
text:
Every night they come rushing
Surround me and
Haunt me
With questions about
Meaning of life
Reason for existence
Whom do you belong to
Who belongs to you
And they give me enough reasons
To end it all
I try to convince and persuade
But they are adamant and persuasive
I Shut them all
Shew them away
Get deaf to them
Struggle to sleep
With teary eyes
Heart pounding
Breathlessness
Yet here I am
To another night
Finding answers to
Meaning of life
Reason to existence
stanzas: And they give me enough reasons
I try to convince and persuade
But they are adamant and persuasive
